label: Give it to me straight
brief: For an adult who knows nothing about this yet. Friendly and casual, like explaining it to a friend over coffee: contractions, short sentences, one idea each, then one everyday picture. No jargon without its plain meaning in the same line, no child framing, no promises. The guide is "the teacher" or "your guide"; the thirty are helpers; Skippy DAX is "your companion".

label: Just curious
voice: A little more detail, still plain words
brief: The mum test: any age, no jargon, warm, concrete.

label: I'm a parent
voice: For someone with a child at the table
brief: A child at the kitchen table, homeschooling welcome. What you can get today, what stays yours, trust.

label: I'm a guide
voice: For someone who teaches, tutors or trains
brief: Runs a room or a session. What you keep (authority, judgement), what you get today, the helpers are only as good as you.

label: I run a team
voice: For someone responsible for other people's learning at work
brief: Onboarding, the one new hire, training that fits the person, enterprise-grade. Every helper's action recorded (accountability is the selling point), any domain.

label: I want to build on it
voice: For someone who wants to make a living with it
brief: Meta DAX stays free and open; the money is in what you build on it: packages for one learner or one segment, sold where educators already sell, educators making and verifying their own packages, products built on the platform (the CMS and the pipelines) that others promote and sell. "A way, never the way" is a constraint on your product too. No revenue numbers, no promises.

label: I build software
brief: Schema, record, agents, contracts, feeds, signed editions. The sampler's builder edition is the model.

label: I fund things
voice: For someone deciding where money goes
brief: What is proven (2024), what is an experiment, what the money does (tokens, guides' time, the record infrastructure), what it unlocks per phase, what is free forever. The Foundation is "the Foundation" and people "support" it; never a legal status word, never a figure.

label: I'm a researcher
voice: For someone who wants the substrate
brief: The evidence, the schema, the experiments' design, the open questions, the severity table (Appendix A of the Constraint post), the definitions. Precise, no softening; the deepest ladder.

label: நிதானமாக, எளிய தமிழில்
brief: Tamil, gently: Sri Lankan Tamil usage, respectful, meaning first, everyday images (the village teacher, palm-leaf records, family letters); no place names; machine-written, unsigned.
